_comment: Selectors a shipped image sends that no iOS 5.1.1 class implements, each with the reason the send is safe. Keyed by file name; '*' applies to every image.

libswiftCore.dylib._swift_bundleForClass:: Selector the runtime itself installs on NSBundle at startup (ObjCRuntimeGetImageNameFromClass.mm PATCH_NSBUNDLE); it is implemented by us.
libswiftCore.dylib._swift_bundleWithExecutablePath:: Helper selector the runtime installs on NSBundle together with _swift_bundleForClass: (ObjCRuntimeGetImageNameFromClass.mm PATCH_NSBUNDLE); implemented by us.
